user.title: Netvue Local
user.description: Discover a camera on the local network or add it by IPv4 address.

discover.title: Discover cameras
discover.description: Choose a local interface. One UDP broadcast is sent on the selected subnet.

select.title: Select a detected camera
select.description: Select a detected address, then choose a camera name.

manual.title: Add a camera
manual.description: Enter a display name and IPv4 address. The integration creates a unique stream and asks the bridge to start it.

error.invalid_input: Invalid IPv4 address or display name.
error.invalid_interface: The selected interface is no longer available.
error.discovery_failed: UDP discovery failed. Check the network or add the camera manually.
error.no_devices: No camera responded. You can add it manually.

abort.no_interfaces: No compatible private IPv4 interface is available.

init.title: Change camera address
init.description: The bridge will stop the old stream and start one for this address.

error.bridge_unavailable: Netvue Bridge is unavailable; the address was not changed.
